background_steps.name: the MCAD Software has a part document open

scenario_steps.name: the upper document region shows labeled appearance previews
the lower library region shows a category tree and labeled appearance thumbnails
preview tiles can show different colors, finishes and textures

scenarios.name: Find a library appearance without a document match

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software has a part document open

scenario_steps.name: the document has no appearance matching "brass"
the active library includes matching brass appearances
I search for "brass"
the document region reports no document match
the library region shows matching appearance thumbnails
the result tree groups matches by library and category

scenarios.name: Change only the document appearance presentation

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software has a part document open

scenario_steps.name: document appearances and library appearances are displayed as thumbnails
I choose List View from the document appearance display menu
document appearances appear in rows with Name, Type and Category columns
the library appearances remain in their thumbnail grid

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software has a part document open

scenario_steps.name: I open the document appearance display menu
it offers sorting by Name, Type, Material Color and Category
it offers thumbnail sizes 16, 24, 32, 64 and 256 pixels

scenarios.name: Inspect a library appearance without an eligible selection

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software has a part document open

scenario_steps.name: no eligible model object is selected
I open the context menu of a matching library appearance
Assign to Selection is disabled
the menu includes Rename, Delete, Where Used and Add to

scenarios.name: Assign a library appearance to the selected part

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software has a part document open

scenario_steps.name: the part is selected in the model browser
the active library contains a brass appearance not yet in the document
I choose Assign to Selection from that appearance's context menu
the appearance is added to the document appearances
the appearance selector shows the assigned appearance
the material selector retains its previously assigned material
the browser remains open
